column1: # GENETEKA HOLDS NO JEWISH RECORDS IN POMORSKIE, AND THAT IS THE RESULT — NOT THE ZEROES.
# geneteka.genealodzy.pl, province 11pm (pomorskie), queried through the site's own api/getAct.php
# and api/getParish.php. Rows 233 and 240. Read 11 October 2026.
# WHY IT WAS RUN. Row 240 proposed a cheap test: Geneteka and the Polish state archives for
# ROSENBERG at Człuchów, which is Schlochau — the district Sally Leibholz was born in, where the
# Gedenkbuch's fifty cluster, and where Jenny Leipholz née Rosenberg was born on 11 February 1893
# to ISIDOR and CECILLIE. Row 233 wants the generation above Sally out of the same ground.
field
# ---------------- THE INSTRUMENT, BECAUSE THE LAST ATTEMPT WAS BROKEN BY A PARAMETER ----------------
the search is an AJAX call and the HTML page carries no results at all
column2: a GET to index.php returns the form and an empty table; the rows come from api/getAct.php, which takes the same query string plus DataTables' draw/start/length and returns JSON. LENGTH IS CAPPED AT FIFTY whatever is asked for. api/getParish.php?search=<place> answers whether a place is indexed at all, which is the question that mattered here.

column1: and the province code is positional, which cost this archive a day in September
column2: 11pm is pomorskie. A code that does not exist falls back SILENTLY to 01ds, dolnośląskie, which is how a Kowalski control once returned zero and correctly condemned the query rather than the surname.

column1: # ---------------- THE CONTROL, AND IT IS THE WHOLE FINDING ----------------
*** GERMAN CHRISTIAN SURNAMES ARE ALIVE IN THIS INDEX AND JEWISH ONES ARE NOT ***
column2: pomorskie births, exact match, whole province: SCHMIDT 1,134 · KOWALSKI 1,023 · MÜLLER 767. And then: COHN 1 · LEVY 0 · LEVIN 0 · ISRAEL 1 · JACOBSOHN 2 · ROSENTHAL 3. Four figures against single digits. ABRAHAM 168 and WOLFF 200 are not counter-examples — both are ordinary Christian surnames in this region and neither is a marker.

column1: WHAT THAT MEANS FOR EVERY QUERY BELOW
column2: GENETEKA'S POMORSKIE HOLDING IS CATHOLIC AND PROTESTANT PARISH BOOKS. A Jewish surname returning zero here is not evidence about that family; it is evidence about the index. THE ZEROES BELOW ARE THEREFORE NOT PUBLISHED AS NEGATIVES, and that is the point of running the control first rather than after.

column1: # ---------------- AND THE COVERAGE BOUND, WHICH IS THE PART THAT TRAVELS ----------------
*** CZŁUCHÓW — SCHLOCHAU ITSELF — IS NOT IN GENETEKA ***
column2: api/getParish.php on "Człuchów" returns ONE place in the whole powiat: PRZECHLEWO. The town the Gedenkbuch cluster is named for has no index.

column1: THE WHOLE POWIAT CZŁUCHOWSKI IS TWO PARISHES AND BOTH STOP BEFORE THE RECORDS WANTED
column2: PRZECHLEWO (rid 890): 1,457 births, EVERY ONE OF THEM BEFORE 1800. DEBRZNO, which is PREUSSISCH FRIEDLAND (rid 1568): 1,649 births, EVERY ONE OF THEM BEFORE 1840 — cumulative counts to 1820, 1830, 1840, 1850, 1874, 1900 and 1939 read 955, 1366, 1649, 1649, 1649, 1649, 1649, so the index is complete by 1840 and adds nothing after it. The province as a whole DOES index this era — a Kowalski control returns 219 births for 1874-1900 and 209 for 1900-1925 — so the gap is this district's, not the century's.

column1: and that closes four people by coverage rather than by silence
column2: JENNY ROSENBERG born Schlochau 1893 · ISIDOR and CECILLIE ROSENBERG, her parents, of Schlochau · HANS LEIBHOLZ born Preussisch Friedland 25 January 1912 · LISELOTT born there in 1920. NOT ONE OF THEM CAN APPEAR IN THIS INDEX HOWEVER THE SEARCH IS RUN. Schlochau has no parish indexed; Preussisch Friedland's stops seventy-two years before Hans was born.

column1: *** AND HAMMERSTEIN IS NOT INDEXED EITHER, WHICH IS ROW 233 ***
column2: Hammerstein is CZARNE in powiat człuchowski. api/getParish.php returns two places called Czarne and NEITHER IS THIS ONE — one is in kujawsko-pomorskie and one is a Greek Catholic parish in małopolskie. SALLY LEIBHOLZ'S BIRTH OF 7 JULY 1847 CANNOT BE REACHED THROUGH GENETEKA. Archiwum Państwowe w Koszalinie had already said on 16 September, reference O-S.6342.406.2026, that there are no German civil registers for Czarne 1874-1899 and no synagogue-community books for Czarne at all. The two answers agree and they close the same door from different sides.

column1: the Pomeranian half of the Gedenkbuch cluster, tested town by town
column2: Of the eleven towns the fifty cluster in, GENETEKA INDEXES TWO. Not indexed: Barwice (Bärwalde/Neustettin) · Szczecinek (Neustettin) · Czaplinek (Tempelburg) · Karwno (Karwen/Stolp) · Główczyce (Glowitz/Stolp) · Słupsk (Stolp) · Miastko (Rummelsburg — the two hits returned are Miastkowo in podlaskie and Miastków Kościelny in mazowieckie, different places) · Czarne (Hammerstein) · Człuchów (Schlochau). Indexed: DEBRZNO, pre-1840, and CHOJNICE.

column1: # ---------------- CHOJNICE, THE ONE DEEP INDEX, AND WHY ITS ZEROES STILL MEAN NOTHING ----------------
CHOJNICE — KONITZ — IS INDEXED PROPERLY AND INTO THE RIGHT CENTURY
column2: rid 194, 6,107 births, cumulative to 1800, 1850, 1874, 1900, 1920 and 1939 reading 625, 1662, 2486, 3481, 4461, 6107. A genuinely deep index covering exactly the years the others do not, in the Kreis town next to Schlochau.

column1: and it returns ZERO for all four surnames across births, marriages and deaths
column2: ROSENBERG 0/0/0 · ROTHENBERG 0/0/0 · LEIBHOLZ 0/0/0 · LEIPHOLZ 0/0/0. *** AND THAT IS NOT A NEGATIVE, BECAUSE THE CONTROL SAYS IT CANNOT BE. *** At Chojnice: SCHMIDT 57, MÜLLER 32, KOWALSKI 17, HOFFMANN 11 — and COHN 0, LEVY 0, ABRAHAM 0, ISRAEL 0. The index is of Christian parish books and holds no Jewish records, so a Jewish family's absence from it is the index speaking, not the register.

column1: # ---------------- THE ONE THING THAT WAS FOUND, AND IT IS NOT OURS ----------------
FORTY-ONE ROSENBERG RECORDS IN POMORSKIE, AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS THIS FAMILY
column2: 18 births, 14 marriages, 9 deaths. They are CATHOLIC AND PROTESTANT PARISH ENTRIES clustered round Gdańsk, Kartuzy and Kościerzyna — Różyny (nine entries, one household, Joannes and Regina, 1758-1769), Gdańsk św. Józef, Gdańsk-Oliwa, Goręczyno, Gowidlino USC, Stara Kiszewa. NONE IN POWIAT CZŁUCHOWSKI. NO ISIDOR AND NO CECILLIE. Rosenberg is an ordinary surname as well as a Jewish one and these are the ordinary kind. Recorded so they are not rediscovered as relatives.

column1: # ---------------- WHAT ROWS 233 AND 240 SHOULD DO INSTEAD ----------------
the half of row 240 that is still untried
column2: THE OTHER PAGES OF TESTIMONY BY THE SAME NEPHEW. A submitter search on Jenny's Page gave seventeen results in September and they are already in data/yadvashem-leibholz.tsv; what has not been done is reading his OWN generation out of them for a Rosenberg of Schlochau. That needs no archive and no fee.

column1: and the instrument the Schlochau records actually need
column2: the German civil registry (Standesamt) books for Schlochau and Hammerstein, which are state-archive holdings and not in any volunteer index. Koszalin has answered for Czarne and said it holds none. SCHLOCHAU ITSELF HAS NOT BEEN PUT TO AN ARCHIVE BY LETTER — Człuchów's records would sit with Archiwum Państwowe w Koszalinie or its Słupsk branch, and that is a letter, not a search.

column1: *** NOTHING HERE IS PUBLISHED AS A NEGATIVE ABOUT A PERSON ***
column2: every zero above is explained by a measured property of the index — no Jewish records in the province, no parish at Schlochau or Hammerstein, and the two indexed parishes of the powiat stopping in 1800 and 1840. A SEARCH THAT COULD NOT HAVE FOUND SOMETHING HAS NOT FAILED TO FIND IT.
